name: Jian
sum: Microraptorine from the Aptian Xiagou Formation of Gansu, China, known from a shoulder girdle and partial forelimb.
holotype: An articulated scapulocoracoid, humerus, radius and ulna, Xiagou Formation, China; first reported in 2010.
biology: Found in a formation that has yielded more than 100 bird fossils.
author: Zhou et al. 2026

sources.text: L. Zhou, M. C. Lamanna, and A. W. Poust, D. Li, H. You, J. K. O.'Connor. 2026. First non-avian theropod (Dromaeosauridae, Microraptorinae) from the bird-bearing Lower Cretaceous Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin, Gansu Province, northwestern China. Annals of Carnegie Museum 92(2):89–110
